name: Key Magic
description:
You bear a Butler's key, handcrafted by the Keymaker.

You have a polished fulgurite glass key, which is imbued with magic. Once per day, you may spend an action to choose one:

  • Your key locks or unlocks a single lock that has a keyhole.

  • You brandish your key in an elegant gesture and a bolt of lightning erupts from it. Roll Courtesy vs Dexterity against a creature within medium range. On a win, your key deals 1d10+HEART damage to the creature. On a loss, half damage. If you are outside during a thunderstorm when you use this ability, triple the damage.

Describe your key.
